summary: Accept bounded paired-client phone latency and live-share observations in original UTC minute windows, with local bounded JSONL history

replay.detail: No graph claims or projection replay. Report deduplication/overlap and live windows are bounded process memory and reset on restart; retained JSONL is not replayed into live windows.

schema.detail: No SQLite table, index or migration. Public client-v0 wire schemas and generated Rust/Swift/TypeScript expose observations.report and a response without snapshot or action receipt.

compatibility.detail: Adds paired-only POST /v1/client/observations and seven client-observed SLO targets to request-latency and doctor. Latency and foreground/live share are distinct types; old clients continue existing calls. Sparse bins use integer milliseconds and shared histogram arithmetic. Minute boundary exclusions and incomplete reported coverage are explicit.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart; no live phone activation or deployment included.

manual.detail: No recorder/transport settings in this change. Optional reporters retry identical disjoint intervals/UUIDs on the same member; acceptance is local, not durable replicated ACK.

recovery.detail: History rotates at 4MiB/day into eight local JSONL segments, expired segments removed on next admission after seven days. Downgrade ignores these files. Memory dedup/overlap resets on restart or oldest-first eviction; retries then can double count. History failures refuse before memory admission; no fsync/power-loss guarantee.
